summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S furnished a Form 6-K containing its third-quarter 2026 earnings press release dated November 12, 2026. Q3 2026 product revenue totaled €366 million (+89% Y/Y): €291 million YORVIPATH, €59 million SKYTROFA, €16 million YUVIWEL. The release reports positive CHMP and COMP opinions for once-weekly TransCon CNP in achondroplasia, a final European Commission decision expected Q4 2026 and a German launch planned Q1 2027, plus Week 52 infant sentinel cohort data and topline pivotal data expected Q3 2027. No transaction, capital event, or governance change is disclosed; this is routine periodic reporting, not a special situation.
